title: Phase 7E Candidate Dataset Comparison
scoring_method: Each criterion scored 0-5 (5=excellent, 0=unknown/poor). Total = average across criteria scaled to 100.

candidates.name: UCI 'Early Stage Diabetes Risk Prediction' (ID 529)
candidates.provenance: Direct questionnaires from Sylhet Diabetes Hospital, Bangladesh; approved by a doctor
candidates.features: 16 binary symptom features + age/gender + binary class
candidates.documentation: UCI variable table; published paper reference
candidates.verification_status: Documented via web; medically sourced (doctor-approved questionnaires); small
candidates.known_limitations: Only diabetes (2 classes); 520 rows; not a general disease-symptom dataset

candidates.name: UCI 'CDC Diabetes Health Indicators' (ID 891)
candidates.provenance: CDC Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS) survey data
candidates.symptom_relevance: Low â€” mostly lifestyle/survey, not physician-verified symptoms
candidates.verification_status: Documented via web; CDC-sourced, real survey data
candidates.known_limitations: Only 3 diabetes classes; features are survey-style, not symptom-based; not a disease-symptom prediction dataset

candidates.name: Kaggle 'Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning' (Kaushil268)
candidates.provenance: Community-submitted; claims symptom/disease mapping; ~42 diseases, 132 binary symptoms
candidates.documentation: Basic Kaggle card; notes 'clean data 42' community rating
candidates.verification_status: Documented via web search only; NOT downloaded/inspected
candidates.known_limitations: Very small total records (~5000); 42 classes with 132 features; reported 100% train accuracy is likely overfitting

candidates.name: IEEE DataPort 'Disease Prediction Dataset' (Ayush Nautiyal et al.)
candidates.provenance: Referenced from MedLinePlus; 1325 symptoms, 391 diseases; academic submission with DOI
candidates.symptom_relevance: High â€” supported by MedLinePlus medical reference
candidates.documentation: IEEE DataPort abstract; academic provenance; DOI: 10.21227/7wgr-a308
candidates.license: IEEE DataPort terms; free access noted
candidates.verification_status: Documented via web search; medical reference cited; NOT inspected directly
candidates.known_limitations: Very large class count (391); most likely tiny per-class support; MedLinePlus-referenced but assembled by students

candidates.name: Kaggle 'Symptom2Disease' (Niyarr Barman)
candidates.provenance: Community-sourced; 24 diseases x 50 symptom descriptions = 1200 rows
candidates.symptom_relevance: Medium â€” text descriptions, not structured binary features
candidates.documentation: Kaggle data card with disease list
candidates.verification_status: Documented via web search only; NOT downloaded
candidates.known_limitations: Requires NLP processing (natural text); 24 diseases only; 1200 rows is small

candidates.name: Kaggle 'Community Healthcare MultiSymptoms-Disease Dataset' (arjunnairedu)
candidates.provenance: Stated as 'simulated' patient records; 174 symptoms, 46 diseases; matches project's structure
candidates.symptom_relevance: High â€” structured binary, directly comparable
candidates.documentation: Kaggle card states 'simulated patient case' and 'clinically structured and realistic'
candidates.verification_status: Documented via web search only; NOT downloaded
candidates.known_limitations: SIMULATED data â€” not real clinical records; 46 diseases / 174 symptoms EXACTLY matches the project, suggesting it may be the same or a sibling synthetic-style dataset

candidates.name: Kaggle 'Symptom to Disease Descriptions (820_Cleaned)'
candidates.provenance: Community; 820 diseases, 654 symptoms; includes column-level and text data
candidates.features: 654 binary symptoms + disease target; plus descriptive text
candidates.known_limitations: 820 classes is far too many for meaningful multiclass evaluation; likely tiny per-class support

candidates.name: Kaggle 'Disease and Symptoms dataset' (Mohamed Medhat AZZAZY)
candidates.symptom_relevance: High column count but unclear structure
candidates.known_limitations: Very wide (378 cols) with few rows; unclear; likely overkill/unmanageable

important_caveat: None of these datasets were downloaded or directly inspected. All information comes from web documentation (Kaggle/UCI/IEEE data cards). Scores reflect documented evidence, not direct verification. Any candidate selected for use REQUIRES manual download + inspection + verification before integration.
